receipt.public_excerpt: GPT‑5 is significantly less likely to hallucinate than our previous models.

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI reports improved capability evaluations and approximately 45% fewer responses containing factual errors than GPT-4o on representative production prompts with browsing enabled. Together with the earlier Claude release, this establishes progress across two successor families, including mitigation of a weakness highlighted in Marcus's post.

The study independently documents increasing task-completion horizons through Claude 3.7 Sonnet. Its software and reasoning tasks corroborate capability progress, while a 50% success threshold does not establish dependable performance in every deployment.

Experienced developers working in familiar repositories were slower with the tested early-2025 tools. This limits any claim of universal practical improvement, but does not contradict the narrower forecast of some expanded applications and partial mitigation of weaknesses.
